name: Princess Sacrifice ~Kugi Hime Feena no Bouken~
original_name: プリンセスサクリファイス～供犠姫フィーナの冒険～
source:
Swords and magic. An age of violence and wonder.
The benevolent gods of old felt abandoned by humans caught up in their own lives.
Thus, gods abandoned humanity. The celestial realm was barren.
Only spirits on the earth remained.

To protect humanity the spirits gave their Powers to maidens of the shrine.

These maidens were known as...
---Sacrificial Princesses---

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE124341.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
剑与魔法交织，那是一个充满暴力与奇迹的时代。
往昔慈悲为怀的众神，因感叹只顾忙于自身生计的人类日渐疏远信仰，
最终抛弃了人类。天界自此化作一片荒芜，
唯有栖息于大地之上的精灵留存世间。

为了守护人类，精灵们将自身的力量赐予了侍奉神殿的巫女少女们。

而这些少女，被世人称作……
——供牺姬——

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE124341.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
